topic: Residential heat-pump installer capacity: market shift, policy, workforce bottleneck and software price anchors

facts.claim: Global heat pump sales declined by 1% in 2024, after a 10% year-on-year drop in the first half of the year.
facts.source_title: IEA Global Energy Review 2025: Main Takeaways for Heat Pumps

facts.claim: Europe, the third-largest heat pump market, saw sales fall 21% in 2024 — the largest decline ever recorded.
facts.source_title: IEA Global Energy Review 2025: Main Takeaways for Heat Pumps

facts.claim: In 2024 German heat pump sales fell by almost 50% and French sales declined by 25%.
facts.source_title: IEA Global Energy Review 2025: Main Takeaways for Heat Pumps

facts.claim: United States heat pump sales rose 15% in 2024 and heat pumps outsold natural gas furnaces by 30%, a record high.
facts.source_title: IEA Global Energy Review 2025: Main Takeaways for Heat Pumps

facts.claim: Global heat pump sales fell by about 2% in 2025.
facts.source_title: Technology: Heat pumps - Global Energy Review 2026, IEA

facts.claim: European heat pump sales rose 11% in 2025, the first year of growth since 2022.
facts.source_title: Technology: Heat pumps - Global Energy Review 2026, IEA

facts.claim: German heat pump sales rose 55% in the first half of 2025, driving Europe's return to growth.
facts.source_title: Technology: Heat pumps - Global Energy Review 2026, IEA

facts.claim: 2025 was the first year in which heat pumps outsold gas boilers in Europe.
facts.source_title: Technology: Heat pumps - Global Energy Review 2026, IEA

facts.claim: Heat pumps still meet less than 15% of heating demand in buildings worldwide.
facts.source_title: Heat Pumps Step Up: What the IEA's Heat Pump Monitor 2026 Means for Heating, Industry and Energy Security

facts.claim: Europe accounts for more than 20% of global heat pump sales by capacity.
facts.source_title: Heat Pumps Step Up: What the IEA's Heat Pump Monitor 2026 Means for Heating, Industry and Energy Security

facts.claim: European heat pump stock is projected to nearly double by 2035 in the IEA Current Policies Scenario.
facts.source_title: Heat Pumps Step Up: What the IEA's Heat Pump Monitor 2026 Means for Heating, Industry and Energy Security

facts.claim: More than 20% of United States households use a heat pump as their primary heating system.
facts.source_title: Heat Pumps Step Up: What the IEA's Heat Pump Monitor 2026 Means for Heating, Industry and Energy Security

facts.claim: Under EPBD Article 17(15), Member States must discontinue any financial incentive for the installation of new stand-alone fossil-fuel boilers from 1 January 2025 at the latest.
facts.source_title: Commission issues guidance on phasing out financing for stand-alone fossil fuel boilers from 2025

facts.claim: The recast Energy Performance of Buildings Directive requires national building renovation plans to include policies aiming at a complete phase-out of fossil-fuel boilers by 2040.
facts.source_title: Energy Performance of Buildings Directive - European Commission

facts.claim: The UK Boiler Upgrade Scheme pays £7,500 towards an air source heat pump, £7,500 towards a ground source heat pump, and £5,000 towards a biomass boiler.
facts.source_title: Apply for the Boiler Upgrade Scheme: What you can get - GOV.UK

facts.claim: An additional £1,500 is available under the Boiler Upgrade Scheme until March 2027 for off-gas-grid properties heated by oil or LPG.
facts.source_title: Apply for the Boiler Upgrade Scheme: What you can get - GOV.UK

facts.claim: To 31 July 2026 the Boiler Upgrade Scheme had received 151,136 voucher applications, issued 101,029 vouchers, redeemed 93,364 vouchers, and paid £661,303,000 in grants.
facts.source_title: BUS monthly scheme update - Ofgem

facts.claim: The US section 25C energy efficient home improvement credit is not allowed for any property placed in service after 31 December 2025.
facts.source_title: FAQs for modification of sections 25C, 25D, 25E, 30C, 30D, 45L, 45W and 179D under Public Law 119-21 (OBBB) - IRS

facts.claim: Gas demand in buildings fell 12% between 2019 and 2024.
facts.source_title: Heat Pumps Step Up: What the IEA's Heat Pump Monitor 2026 Means for Heating, Industry and Energy Security

facts.claim: The European Commission estimates that 750,000 more installers are needed and at least 50% of existing installers will have to be reskilled to work with heat pumps.
facts.source_title: Heat pumps - European Commission, Energy

facts.claim: EU heat pump installations were 2.8 million units in 2022, 2.7 million in 2023, 2.11 million in 2024 and 2.34 million in 2025 (preliminary data from 13 Member States).
facts.source_title: Heat pumps - European Commission, Energy

facts.claim: EHPA states Europe needs a minimum of 500,000 skilled full-time-equivalent employees in the heat pump sector by 2030.
facts.source_title: Wanted: half a million heat pump workers - European Heat Pump Association

facts.claim: Around 117,000 people were employed in the European heat pump industry, roughly 37% of them in manufacturing, across more than 170 manufacturing sites with €14.5 billion annual turnover (EHPA, January 2023).
facts.source_title: Wanted: half a million heat pump workers - European Heat Pump Association

facts.claim: EHPA states that 7 million more heat pumps must be installed annually by 2030, up from approximately 2 million in 2021.
facts.source_title: Wanted: half a million heat pump workers - European Heat Pump Association

facts.claim: Nearly 800,000 people work principally on heat pumps globally.
facts.source_title: Heat Pumps Step Up: What the IEA's Heat Pump Monitor 2026 Means for Heating, Industry and Energy Security

facts.claim: The global heat pump workforce is projected to grow 30% by 2035 in the Current Policies Scenario, 60% in the Stated Policies Scenario and up to 140% in the Net Zero Emissions Scenario.
facts.source_title: Heat Pumps Step Up: What the IEA's Heat Pump Monitor 2026 Means for Heating, Industry and Energy Security

facts.claim: The number of UK heat pump engineers was estimated at around 3,000 (Nesta, July 2022).
facts.source_title: The heat pump installer gap - Nesta

facts.claim: Nesta estimates the UK will need at least 27,000 qualified heat pump engineers by 2028, rising to about 62,000 by 2035.
facts.source_title: The heat pump installer gap - Nesta

facts.claim: Meeting UK targets requires training roughly 5,000 to 7,000 heat pump installers per year from 2025 to 2035.
facts.source_title: The heat pump installer gap - Nesta

facts.claim: In a survey of 345 UK heat pump installers (fieldwork October-November 2023), 30% named finding suitable additional staff as the biggest barrier to doing more installations, rising to 41% among firms with six or more staff; lack of customer demand was cited by 41% overall.
facts.source_title: Heat pump engineers held back on installations by staff shortages - Nesta

facts.claim: 81% of surveyed UK installer firms with six or more staff said they were likely or very likely to employ new staff in the next 12 months.
facts.source_title: Heat pump engineers held back on installations by staff shortages - Nesta

facts.claim: A shortage of skilled installers, planners and technicians remains one of the main bottlenecks to scaling heat pump deployment in Europe.
facts.source_title: Heat pumps need people: closing the skills gap - European Heat Pump Association

facts.claim: Jobber publishes list pricing for field-service software at $49/month (Core, 1 user), $139/month (Connect, 1 user), $199/month (Grow, 5 users) and $499/month (Plus, 5 users), with additional users at $29/month.
facts.source_title: Pricing - Jobber

facts.claim: The UK passed 250,000 MCS-certified heat pump installations in February 2026; 2025 was the strongest year on record at 34% above 2024, and the Boiler Upgrade Scheme funded 43% of 2025 installations.
facts.source_title: UK reaches 250,000 certified heat pump installations - MCS

facts.claim: Germany alone has around 900 MW of district-heating heat pump capacity under construction or in planning.
facts.source_title: Heat Pumps Step Up: What the IEA's Heat Pump Monitor 2026 Means for Heating, Industry and Energy Security

facts.claim: China holds about 35% of global heat pump manufacturing capacity and held roughly one-third of all heat pump patents in 2022.
facts.source_title: Heat Pumps Step Up: What the IEA's Heat Pump Monitor 2026 Means for Heating, Industry and Energy Security
